svg.title: One item texture, two regions
svg.desc: The texture of Brimstone from the build at 4x. Region A in the top-left corner keeps the original art for the HUD, the held-item animation and the collection page. Region B below holds a 4/3 copy of the art with the name, quality and description; pedestals and shops show only region B, at 75 %.

g.font-family: 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Noto Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: The HUD, the item held over Isaac’s head and the collection
page always cut this corner, so it stays untouched.
B · a 4/3 copy of the art with the text
On pedestals and in shops the patched animation shows only
this part, at 75 %, so the art comes back to its normal size.
Hidden pedestals swap the texture for a question mark. The build
draws its own “?” in both regions, so it does not disappear.
